info.text: The main factors that will have an impact on the remote control are cost, complexity, and size.
The available components for the remote control are buttons, a wheel (like a mouse scroll wheel), and an LCD display.
The case of the remote control can be either flat or curved, and can be made of different materials such as plastic, rubber, wood, or titanium.
There are restrictions on combining certain materials, such as rubber and titanium, and on using certain materials with certain power sources.
The power options for the remote control are a standard battery, a wind-up crank, a solar power cell, and a kinetic power source.
The kinetic power source could be used as a gimmick, such as a shake-to-power feature.
From a production point of view, the less components used and the simpler the components, the lower the cost and the faster the time to market.
The user interface restrictions mean that more complicated features require more complicated logic.
The LCD panel requires power and could be used to provide feedback to the user.
The kinetic power source could be used to trigger a light or other feature.
The shape and design of the remote control will have an impact on the user experience and the technical feasibility.
The use of an LCD display or a speaker to provide feedback to the user is a design decision that needs to be made.
The placement of the buttons and other components will have an impact on the usability and design of the remote control.

summary: The remote control design is impacted by cost, complexity, and size. Available components include buttons, wheel, and LCD display. Power options are standard battery, wind-up crank, solar power cell, and kinetic power source. Design decisions must balance user experience, technical feasibility, and production considerations.

info.text: The target group for the product is 15 to 35 years old.

summary: The product targets 15-35 year olds. It will use battery power, categorize audio and visual functions, and ignore tele-text. The design may include yellow, a jog dial, and a curvy shape. The product could incorporate speech recognition and the corporate slogan.
